transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
Well, I came in for my five-month diabetes and blood pressure check, but I have been having some pain in my right shoulder. That's really the only thing that's bothering me.
When did you first notice it?
I'm not sure of the exact date, but I know there was no injury or anything like that before it started. It just began on its own.
Is there anything that makes it better or worse?
Certain movements of my shoulder make it hurt. I haven't really noticed anything that makes it better.
How would you describe the feeling in your own words?
It's just pain in my right shoulder. I haven't had any weakness, numbness or tingling along with it.
Where exactly do you feel it, and does it spread anywhere?
It's in my right shoulder. I haven't noticed it spreading anywhere else.
On a scale from 0 to 10, where 10 is the worst, how bad is it?
I couldn't really put a number on it. It's just uncomfortable with certain movements, but I haven't thought of it that way.
Is it there all the time, or does it come and go?
I'm not sure I can say for certain. I just notice it when I make certain movements with my shoulder.
Has anything else been bothering you along with this?
No, nothing else. No weakness, numbness or tingling. Just the shoulder pain as my main concern, along with coming in for my check.
Do you see a doctor regularly for any health condition?
Yes, I have type 2 diabetes and high blood pressure. That's why I come in for these check-ups every few months.
Which medicines do you take regularly, including any new ones?
I do take medication for my diabetes and my blood pressure, but I'm sorry, I can't remember the names of them right now.
Are you allergic to any medicines?
No, I'm not allergic to any medicines that I know of.
Has this changed what you can do around the house or outside?
I haven't noticed it stopping me from doing things. It just hurts with certain movements of my shoulder, so I try to avoid those.
Is there anything about this that worries you?
No, not really. It's more of a nuisance than anything, and I came mainly for my regular check.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
